name: claude-deepseek-bridge
description: Let Claude Code offload token-heavy, file-based chores to DeepSeek — sandboxed, cheaper, you stay in control.

enumDescriptions: V4 Pro — advanced reasoning, higher cost
deepseekBridge.model.description: Default DeepSeek model used for delegated work.

enumDescriptions: Prompt me before Claude switches model
Let Claude choose Flash vs Pro per task
deepseekBridge.modelAuto.description: Whether Claude may switch between Flash and Pro per task.

enumDescriptions: Edit — DeepSeek may read and write files
Read-only — DeepSeek may only read files
deepseekBridge.posture.description: Maximum file-access level granted to DeepSeek (per-call requests are clamped to this).

enumDescriptions: Delegate only large, clearly token-heavy chores
Delegate aggressively — keep Claude's context lean
deepseekBridge.delegationAggressiveness.description: How eagerly Claude should offload work to DeepSeek. Tunes the guidance written to your CLAUDE.md and the MCP tool hints.

enumDescriptions: Write delegation guidance to this workspace's CLAUDE.md
Write delegation guidance to your global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
Do not write any delegation guidance
deepseekBridge.injectGuidance.markdownDescription: Where to write the managed delegation-policy block that tells Claude **when** to offload. This is what makes offloading automatic. The block is fenced with markers and never touches your own content.

deepseekBridge.allowCommands.description: Shell command prefixes DeepSeek may run for self-verification without a popup (e.g. "npm test", "git").

deepseekBridge.fullPermissions.markdownDescription: ⚠️ Auto-approve **all** shell commands without prompting. Trusted environments only.

deepseekBridge.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. Point this at a regional mirror, self-hosted DeepSeek, or a corporate LLM proxy if needed.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with DeepSeek Bridge
walkthroughs.description: Offload token-heavy work from Claude to DeepSeek in four steps.

steps.title: Check requirements
steps.description:
You need Claude Code installed and a DeepSeek API key (free at platform.deepseek.com).
[Get a DeepSeek API key](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys)

steps.title: Add your API key
steps.description:
Open the DeepSeek Bridge sidebar and paste your API key.
[Open Settings](command:deepseek-bridge.openSidebar)

steps.title: Choose model & permissions
steps.description:
Pick a model, set how eagerly Claude should delegate, and choose a permission posture.
[Open Settings](command:deepseek-bridge.openSidebar)

steps.title: Reconnect & try it
steps.description:
Reconnect Claude Code so it loads the bridge, then ask Claude to do something big.
[Reconnect Claude Code](command:deepseek-bridge.reconnect)

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:ext && npm run bundle:server
scripts.watch: npm run bundle:ext -- --watch & npm run bundle:server -- --watch
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
